question: What degree of effort is required when obtaining material released from fire?
premises: The preceding context establishes the sourcing of ritual material.
Material released from fire is to be obtained.
The prescribed means is effort that is total.
inference: Therefore, one should obtain fire-released material with all possible effort.
uncertainties: The precise nature of vahni-muktaṃ (fire-released material) depends on the ritual context of the preceding verses.
plain_english: Therefore, one should bring what has been released from the fire with every effort.
